changedRule: presence is refused; only departure cuts a source, sends a wrong fragment, and hollows a third form
memoryRule: later fields keep failed departures; each retained absence notches one loose form, misplaces a fragment into a distant form, and removes an inner mark from a third
interactionRule: pointer entry and proximity produce no visual change; pointer departure, Enter, Space, and the control produce the same bounded event; undo restores the exact prior field

rupture.encounter: look triggers an immediate answer -> presence is refused and absence commits the event
